need.title: Election & Annual Meeting Information — proxy, voting certificate, paper ballot rules
need.body: Oct 13 TownSq from Megan Heins: Proxy is for quorum only (need 30% or 487 of 1,623 lots). Use pink Proxy Envelope or submit electronically on Get Quorum (email sent Oct 12; contact mheins@castlegroup.com if missing). Voting Certificate only if multi-owner, corporation, trust, LLC, or other entity. Paper ballot must include date, lot # (if known), address, print name, owner signature (only one name/signature required). Only one vote per household counted (first online or electronic). Secret election: ONLY the ballot in the small ballot envelope — if proxy or voting certificate is inside, vote will not count. Questions to mheins@castlegroup.com.

need.title: Michael Ross withdrew from the board election
need.body: Oct 9 12:39 PM ET TownSq: Michael Ross has withdrawn his candidacy for the Board of Directors election. Remaining candidates for the one open seat: Kevin Dawyskiba, Ronald Sedlak, Stacey Weber. Candidates Night Thu Oct 22 5:00 PM Zoom is unchanged except the slate.

announce.title: Pop-Up Complimentary Lunch & Learn: Understanding Florida Home Insurance — Nov 5
announce.body: Thursday, November 5 | 12:00 PM – 1:00 PM at Beachwalk at Manasota – Card Room 3. Complimentary Lunch & Learn with Chace Caminiti, Licensed Insurance Agent with Brightway Insurance. Learn about Florida's home insurance market changes, what to expect at renewal, tips to protect your home. Complimentary lunch provided. RSVP required — space limited.
